route: Lido di Camaiore - Lido di Camaiore
story: Stage 1 of Tirreno–Adriatico began with drama as Oded Kogut crashed in the first corner. Alan Hatherly held the hot seat for a long time before Magnus Sheffield improved the benchmark. Among GC contenders, Thymen Arensman impressed in second, but Filippo Ganna dominated the time trial, winning by 22 seconds. Wout van Aert, starting early, appeared to take a quieter day.
